events.context: Suggests telling her: '视频先不打了，再看下去我怕自己干傻事。' and follow-up '比如半夜飞过去找你。' as honest, non-vulgar, romantic response.
Identifies true fears: rejection, seeming frivolous, breaking balance; contrasts with current painful balance of viewing photos without messaging.
Offers paths: A. Act on desire, B. Pause contact, C. Continue current routine; notes C chooses pain over her.
User says: '我怎么会变成这样' (How did I become like this?).
Outlines 5 stages of user's emotional progression: meeting ideal person, defensiveness, discovering it works, getting stuck, self-loathing.
Interprets as question about uncontrollable sexual desire, not personality change.
Explains not 'uncontrollable' but 'unwilling to stop' due to no outlet; formula: liking × intimacy × distance.
Three paths: release (self-relief then decide), convert to action (meet/voice desire), transfer (exercise/cold shower/work).
User admits: '我现在每天都自己解决。小猫不停地骂我。' (I masturbate daily. Little cat keeps scolding me.)
Questions if real scolding or internalized voice; addresses both cases.
User repeats: '我现在每天都自己解决。小猫骂我，说这样会把生身体毁掉。' (She says it will ruin my body.)
Debunks myth: masturbation doesn't ruin body; her concern is emotional (heartache, substitution).
Proposes replies like '那你要不要来拯救一下？' (Want to come save me?) to turn scolding into flirtation.
User says: '我说每天自己解决不会把身体毁掉，她说肯定会。' (I said it won't ruin body, she insists it will.)
Medically user correct, relationally she is; her fear is replacement; suggests non-confrontational replies.
User asks: '我的性欲是不是真的很强' (Is my sexual desire really that strong?).
Provides data table showing daily frequency normal (15-25%); issue is lack of outlet + guilt, not strength.
User asks: '我怎么观察她想不想要我' (How do I observe if she wants me?).
